WITH grouped AS (
  SELECT ili.order_item_id,
         p.product_color,
         AVG(CAST(ili.product_quantity AS DECIMAL(19,4))) AS average_quantity,
         AVG((ili.derived_product_cost - ili.derived_total_cost) / NULLIF(ili.derived_total_cost, 0)) AS average_cost_ratio
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items AS ili
  JOIN Order_Items AS oi ON oi.order_item_id = ili.order_item_id
  JOIN Products AS p ON p.product_id = ili.product_id
  GROUP BY ili.order_item_id, p.product_color
), ranked AS (
  SELECT order_item_id,
         product_color,
         average_quantity,
         average_cost_ratio,
         RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY product_color ORDER BY average_quantity DESC NULLS LAST) AS rank
  FROM grouped
)
SELECT order_item_id, product_color, average_quantity, average_cost_ratio, rank
FROM ranked
WHERE rank <= 3;
